statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated
The service is to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and Z86.73
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
